fusions.name: Cracked Coconut
fusions.desc: Throws a hard-shelled nut that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Cymbal Clash
fusions.desc: Slams the head down with a clang, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fidget Rhythm
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Pocketed Breath
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, you recover 3 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
